question: Does cumulative acquisition of two actual source facts improve never-queried composed answers while preserving all previously acquired facts?
hypothesis: On all 5760 unqueried target labels, two sequential impact-selected source answers gain at least 58 correct (one percentage point rounded up) over one impact-selected answer, at least 116 over no query, are no worse than two fixed-first source answers, and within 57 of both same-information converged conventional heads. Every original and acquired fact, immutable source bank, and cold checkpoint must survive both steps. Any threshold miss is NEGATIVE, failed controls INVALID.
data: Identical WSP29 120 actual acquired modules including 13 imperfect; 60 pairs x16 completions x2 recipes=1920 worlds. Initial source facts6 per bank and5 target facts at0,1,2,4,7. All three target inputs3,5,6 are NEVER queried by any arm and are common heldout scoring points. All hidden truth stays evaluator-only, except selected actual source answer after question selection. No filtering, new seeds, private first-use or task/recipe identity to learner.

arms.source_two: Two sequential source queries selected using decision sensitivity, replanning from actual augmented evidence after first answer.
arms.source_first_two: Two fixed-first remaining unknown source questions, same maximum memory.
arms.source_one: One impact-selected source answer, same memory architecture, second answer disabled.
arms.no_query: Identical fact memory with zero new answers.

mechanism: Reuse WSP31 actual-known-fact overlay, 12-route numerical first-best refit and four source question descriptors. No target question permitted. Counterfactual0/1 branch answers only to remaining unknown source addresses, score prediction disagreements at three unknown target inputs, first-maximum selects. Caches invalidate after actual write; before answering the second query restore the first-answer checkpoint. No oracle labels/tables in checkpoints. Actual known labels never overwritten; duplicate identical evidence idempotent, contradiction/unsolicited/budget overrun rejects atomically.
capacity: Same 206 binary values as WSP31 before query flag plus a 2-bit counter0..2=208 persistent value bits. Mode tags/budgets are programmed policies, not learned knowledge. 16 derived fallback bits and up to4 two-bit impact scores=24 derived bits, maximum232 resident value bits before program, transient two-branch states and Python metadata. At most two of four unknown source facts acquired, fixed bounded memory; no arbitrary lifelong memory claim.
controls: Both WSP31 genuine trained controls yoked to each arm's actual evidence: two converged8-logit source fits and two20-weight target heads(shared native features; learned-source features). Unchanged AdamLR0.1/BCE<=.01/4096updates. Exact cache key includes actual complete evidence, payload hashes, representations, optimizer and source provenance. 30720 logical fits; count fresh fits, hits, updates and cache bytes. Strong exact symbolic execution of effective tables must agree with every native output. Capacity/priors/cost differ, not universal or efficiency superiority.
retention: Check all12 original source+5 original target facts after each answer; check first answer after second; source-locality checks for every write; bank bytes unchanged; cold restoration at every phase, selected questions invariant under identical actual evidence; equal augmented evidence implies equal predictions. Full-budget unknown queries stop, repeated known evidence no mutation, negative controls in tests.
budget: One frozen full assay all1920 worlds/four arms, max2 real source answers per arm; no restarts/tuning after valid result. Max30min hosted job. Reuse immutable module acquisition, no repeat training of source circuits. Native cost planning, refits, temporary states, replay and cold checks counted in walltime; no matched FLOP/energy claim.
qualification: Focused controls then full final original+WSP01-17/WSP19-32 unit regression, full frozen WSP32 assay, permanent G29, clean exact source on hosted Ubuntu and Windows2022. Reuse existing WSP21 workflow. Preserve complete result/provenance in repo.
authority: Isolated public DEV draft only; no main/accepted refs, merge, deployment, owner/controller/runner/queue/scheduler changes, paid APIs, protected first-use, Hybrid or FORGE changes. Scientific superiority unverified even if DEV thresholds pass.
